_comment: Copy to liveness-hosts.local.json (gitignored) to extend posting-liveness host handling without publishing your board list.
_sessionGated: Hosts that only show real posting state to a signed-in session. Any text-based verdict from them is discarded; only HTTP 404/410 counts as expired. Use this for boards that serve login walls or bot challenges to unauthenticated fetches. Read once at startup: restart the app after editing this list.
